text: Mom, have you seen my magazine?
I think it's in the living room next to the TV.
Now where's today's newspaper? I can't find it anywhere.
Oh, I was reading it. It's on the sofa, between the cushions.
Do you know where the remote control is?
Look in the living room. I think I saw it in front of the TV.
Where's my tennis racket? Did Dad borrow it again? I wish he'd ask me.
I saw it in your bedroom, under your bed.
